files.name: NetherHealFirst.java

help: In the Nether, hurt (<14 hp) before fortress find: step off lava/fire, eat to full, wait until health is 18
lesson: Fortress find DIED at 0 s right after a run of magma-cube fights suggests the search restarts wounded. Healing in a safe spot between the fight and the walk goes after the death itself, not the route.
summary: nether_heal_first: before fortress find resumes in the Nether with health under 14, step off visible lava/fire, eat to full hunger and stand still until health is 18 again, so the bot doesn't go back to walking at low health after a fight
